name: tabocalypse-reaper
description: ## Approach validation & assumptions - **Shallow hierarchy (Host → Cluster) is faster** than deep trees for scanning/closing; aligns with Sidebery/Tab Manager patterns. (Refs below) - **Cluster keys**: first path segment; GitHub = org/repo; AWS = first segment. Good balance of meaning vs. complexity. - **Counts**: bottom‑up unique IDs; cluster = length; host = union of clusters. - **Favicons**: enable via CSP `img-src https: data: moz-extension:`; significantly improves scan speed. - **Theme adaptation**: try `browser.theme.getCurrent()`; fallback `prefers-color-scheme`. - **Bulk close**: single `tabs.remove([...])` per group.

scripts.prepare: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && npm run copy:assets
scripts.build: npm run prepare && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run prepare && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.dev: npm run prepare && npm-run-all --parallel watch:ts watch:assets web-ext:run
